description: Defines the CommandLine class for building and parsing command line arguments, including switch handling and argument management.

classes.name: CommandLine
classes.description: A class for constructing, parsing, and managing command line arguments and switches.

methods.name: CommandLine
methods.description: Constructs a CommandLine object from argc and argv or a vector of strings.

methods.name: HasSwitch
methods.description: Checks if a switch is present in the command line.

methods.name: AppendSwitch
methods.description: Adds a switch with an optional value to the command line.

methods.name: GetSwitchValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a switch.

methods.name: AppendArg
methods.description: Adds an argument to the command line.

methods.name: AppendArguments
methods.description: Appends arguments and switches from another CommandLine object.
